sample_unit: landmark RCTs (NEJM) interpreted by each of four LLMs

links.outcome: LLM concordance with published clinical trial conclusions on benchmark RCT interpretation
links.effect: Concordance with published conclusions: ChatGPT 100.0%, Gemini 84%, Grok3 72%, Claude 68%; possible training-data contamination may inflate alignment.
links.quote: ChatGPT demonstrated the highest concordance with published conclusions at 100.0%, followed by Gemini at 84%, Grok3 at 72%, and Claude at 68%.

unlisted_practices: Using LLMs to summarize and interpret clinical trial evidence for evidence synthesis

screen.reason: Evaluates the benchmark accuracy/concordance of four LLMs (ChatGPT, Gemini, Grok3, Claude) in interpreting clinical trial data against published RCT conclusions without evaluating a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
